title: BuildTest repository preparation and output admission
alt: Core saves the accepted seed before Environment reserves one operation. The trusted native init container prepares the exact repository before the command runs. A separate read-only collector seals the full baseline and declared output bytes from the prepared native path. Environment stores exact preparation and capture references, not file bytes. Core uses retained Source Control bytes and the existing Events journal acknowledgment. Environment verifies that canonical acknowledgment through Core before deleting the exact native Pods. Core then commits the terminal receipt under current owner checks. Retries do not restart the command or replace sealed bytes. This figure describes source behavior, not native Kubernetes acceptance.
